text: Page scrolls when exiting tab switcher

Chrome Version: Top of tree (93.0.4558.0)
OS: iOS

What steps will reproduce the problem?
(1) Open a web site
(2) Open tab switcher
(3) Press Done

What is the expected result?
Page does not scroll down

Chris, PTAL. The tab scrolls down a little more every time it is entered from the tab grid.

I think this is likely related to fullscreen handling and not lower down in web, but please re-assign to gambard@ if this looks like an issue inside web.

[Monorail components: Mobile>iOSWeb UI>Browser>FullScreen]

Hm looking into this, if it was a fullscreen issue, then part of the page would be blocked or we would see white space. Instead, this seems to be an issue where the page is scrolled down, making me believe that this had to do with something other than fullscreen. Any scrollview manipulation in fullscreen is the contentInset, which impacts where the top of the content starts in the view, not the content offset. Gauthier, is there somewhere in /web where we manage the scrollview's content offset?
Logging the fullscreen insets set every time it is updated, I don't see it changing before and after entering the tab switcher. Makes me really think it can't be fullscreen.
Applying M92 RBS per https://crbug.com/chromium/1225293. Please remove if needed.
This issue is also present in both Fullscreen Smooth Scrolling being on or off. In fact, when it is off, every time you repeat the tab switcher -> Done, it continuously shifts the page.
Given that this is easy to reproduce (e.g., on www.wikipedia.org), perhaps we should bisect Canary builds between 91.0.4472.0 and 92.0.4515.0.
https://ci.chromium.org/ui/p/chrome/builders/ci/canary-simulator/2558/overview is the canary build where the bug first appears
https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/2872925 is the culprit CL, but still trying to figure out why.
Any further progress here as this is M92 RBS and we're cutting M92 Stable RC next week?

[ios] Update toolbar state before starting broadcasting

crrev.com/2872925 removed the [self updateToolbarState] before
broadcasting begins, which means a height of 0 is passed initially
into the fullscreen logic.
Thanks, I think this should go into M92. Waiting for verification in next canary.
